# Your Daily Briefing - Friday 20 November

Yesterday was a quieter day with no structured training and 6,383 steps — solid enough movement without overdoing it. You burned 2,394 kcal, which sits just above your 2,300 target, so intake and output were nicely balanced. The main flag is sleep at just 5.7 hours — that's the number worth paying attention to today.

Your HRV of 71ms is noticeably below your 90-119ms baseline, and that short sleep is almost certainly the reason. Your body is signalling it needs more recovery, so if today has a hard session planned, consider dialling it back to something easy — a Zone 2 run or gentle movement rather than intensity.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything else. Aim for 8 hours and limit screen time after 9pm. Hit your 175g protein today too — it'll support recovery even on lighter training days. You've got this! 💪
